$comment: Accepted duplicated lines per file pair. A value is the line count on its own, or `{"lines": N, "reason": "…"}` when somebody looked at the duplication and decided it stays. `pnpm check jscpd-frontend` shrink-wraps the numbers, so a reason is the only part written by hand. Adding an entry, or raising a number, needs David's OK (`.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md`).
